messages:
Leo (AtlasAI): hi team — our similarity index broke this morning. some /v1/embeddings calls are returning vectors of length 512 when we expect 1536. about 15% of requests fail, started 2026-03-15T14:21Z. trace id sample trace_20260315_01. any ideas?

Mia (Support): ugh, sorry to hear that. can you share the exact request you're sending (headers and body)? are you using a project token only or also sending an org header?

Leo (AtlasAI): sanitized curl below:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer proj_AbCdEf123\" \
  -H \"X-Org-ID: org_atlas_999\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"atlas-embed-large\",\"input\":\"hello world\"}'
```

we recently started injecting X-Org-ID from our proxy. when we temporarily removed that header the issue went away.

Raj (Infra): can you paste one failing response (vector length) and any response headers? does it happen on both single and batched inputs?

Leo (AtlasAI): working responses are 1536 floats. failing ones are 512. no model info in body. happens for both single and batched.

Mia (Support): tagging @Raj @Sylvia for routing and infra. my hunch: routing may be honoring org-level defaults that map to an older 512 embed model, overriding the model in request body.

Sylvia (SRE): grabbing routing traces. can you share a request_id from a bad response? you mentioned trace_20260315_01 but full req id would help.

Leo (AtlasAI): req_1785432110_a7b attached.

Raj (Infra): found log:

```
[2026-03-15T14:21:50Z] req=req_1785432110_a7b org=org_atlas_999 project=proj_AbCdEf123 headers=[Authorization,X-Org-ID] resolved_route=embeddings/legacy-embed-512 reason=\"org default matched\"
```

Raj (Infra): looks like a config change on 2026-03-10 flipped header precedence so org mappings trumped explicit model param for embeddings. that would explain the 512 vectors.

Mia (Support): OK that's the root cause. short-term fix: change routing precedence so project token and explicit model field win. longer-term: server-side validation to detect dimension mismatch and return an explicit 400 with actionable message.

Sylvia (SRE): pushed a hotfix to routing-catalog to lower org precedence and restarted routing-service in prod after staging test. excerpt:

```
embeddings:
  precedence:
    - project_token
    - request_body.model
    - org_id
```

kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/routing-service

deploy-bot: rollout start deploy/routing-service sha=sha256:abcd1234

deploy-bot: rollout complete deploy/routing-service sha=sha256:abcd1234 in 28s

Raj (Infra): temporary debugging headers added to responses:

Response-Resolved-Model: atlas-embed-large
Response-Resolved-Dims: 1536

Leo (AtlasAI): re-tested with our proxy still adding X-Org-ID. new responses are all 1536. sample request_id: req_1785432702_f1c. latency unchanged.

Sylvia (SRE): scoped impact: ~0.8% of embedding traffic affected over the window for orgs with defaults. hotfix in prod. working on dimension validation rollout.

Mia (Support): actions:
- Raj: land routing precedence fix to main + add integration test (PR #4523). ETA 24h.
- Sylvia: implement dims-check and enable on canary; return 400 with code \"embedding_dimension_mismatch\" when mismatch detected. ETA 48h.
- Support: notify customers affected and provide mitigation (remove org header or wait for patch).

Raj (Infra): PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/pulls/4523 adds a test ensuring request body model wins when present.

Sylvia (SRE): planned error payload when validation is enabled:

```
HTTP 400 {
  \"error\": \"embedding_dimension_mismatch\",
  \"message\": \"Requested model 'atlas-embed-large' expects 1536 dims but resolved model 'legacy-embed-512' returned 512 dims. Check project token and org defaults.\"
}
```

Mia (Support): Leo, i'll publish an internal KB summarizing precedence: project token > request body model > org defaults. will paste link here shortly.

deploy-bot: kb-page created: /kb/embeds-routing-precedence-2026-03-15

Leo (AtlasAI): thanks all, patch looks good. please keep thread open until validation is live and the KB is published.

Mia (Support): will do. marking for follow-up after validation rollout. :thumbsup: 

Sylvia (SRE): added a telemetry alert: if >0.5% of a customer's embedding responses differ in dims from requested model for 30m then page oncall and create incident draft.

Leo (AtlasAI): appreciated. closing on our side after QA signal. :white_check_mark:
